caption: The drawing features a single large tankard, depicted in profile view, occupying most of the center and left side of the page. It is rendered in fine black lines on an off-white background. The tankard has a wide cylindrical body that tapers slightly as it rises, and a flat, circular base adorned near the bottom with a band of repeating sharp-edged, leaf-like patterns. The tankard's handle is large and curved, attached at the top and base, and includes a thumb rest near its upper end. The tankard has a hinged, domed lid that is attached by an ornate thumb lever featuring a spiral motif at the top. There is a small rectangular mark near the top center of the tankard’s body. The artist's signature, "Lawrence Flynn," appears at the bottom right corner of the image. The composition is otherwise unembellished, with no background elements or additional objects.
title: Silver Tankard
